items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Coleman and he came out, and I was out in Cali now going to USC, and they would come out and we would go to jam sessions

ctx.x: So the roots of my family is in Arkansas.
Me and George Coleman were two years apart in Manassas.
Wow. So I wanted to ask about your cultural roots, and your earliest memories in Memphis, and also Sally “Sunflower” Whitecloud, if you could tell me about those thing please.
